sloka: ततो अब्रवीत् सुसम्क्रुद्धो वज्र दम्ष्ट्रो महाबलः ।प्रगृह्य परिघम् घोरम् माम्स शोणित रूपितम् ॥६-८-९॥।।
transliteration: tato abravīt susamkruddho vajra damṣṭro mahābalaḥ ।pragṛhya parigham ghoram māmsa śoṇita rūpitam ॥6-8-9॥।।

translations.english: Then a mighty strong one who was endowed with diamond like teeth highly enraged, clasping a dreadful iron bludgeon stained with flesh and blood spoke.
